1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar Gamuda Cove) 2019.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 6 September 2019.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang lebih daripada

kelajuan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama di atas jalan yang

dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) dilarang.

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (BANDAR GAMUDA COVE INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Bandar Gamuda Cove

Interchange) Order 2019.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 6 September 2019.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of motor vehicles at a speed greater than the speed

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1)

is prohibited.

(2) The road with the speed limit specified under subparagraph (1)

is shown on the map in the Second Schedule.
